description: The source reports greenhouse-gas area fugitive emissions from tailings ponds and mine faces at Alberta oil-sands mining facilities for 2011–2021. It also includes produced bitumen and diluent volumes flared or wasted from Alberta Energy Regulator statistical report ST-39. One XLSX distribution is listed. These are operational and emissions observations for mining infrastructure. Reporting occurred under TIER and preceding regulations; exact greenhouse-gas units, estimation methods and individual facility coverage are not stated in the inspected metadata. The Canadian Urban Data Catalogue preserves the source title, description and original Alberta identifiers. The record labels the material Open Government Licence - Alberta. Costs, current file access and numerical contents are unverified. No linked document, workbook, archive, installer or data body was fetched. Specific simulation uses remain unstated unless described above.
